text: Fixed. In `src/click/core.py`, `Option.__init__` unconditionally set `self.default = False` for flags when no default was given, which made a `required=True` flag look like it had a value and skip the "Missing option" check. It now only forces that default when the flag is not required (`if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required`). A required flag given no argument now exits with code 2 and "Error: Missing option '--flag'." while `--flag` still works. Full test suite still passes (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).
